sentences.text:
Through: Mr.Gaurav 
 
 Raj Kumar & Ors.

Through: 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli
 Order
% 22.05.2023
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2.
The application stands disposed of.

CM APPL. 21390/2023 (delay 40 days)
3.
This is an application filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 40 days' delay in filing the appeal.
4. The application is, for the reasons stated therein, allowed.
Consequently, the delay of 40 days in filing the appeal stands condoned.
5. The application stands disposed of.

6. The present appeal preferred by the claimants under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal vide its impugned award dated 17.12.2022.
